notes: Oracle is GliderScore's own computation over R1-R9: the Overall Results report transcribed verbatim into overall-results-transcript.csv (sha256 b122b52a5fed31638c8d8205a94832ad71c31ea739810d3e9579bd865de4bc2c).

'*' prefix marks the single dropped score: exactly one '*' per pilot, on Rnd9 — Drop1@5 is the only drop that activates (five distinct rounds carry RawScore>0; Drop2@9 never reaches its threshold), and it lands on the latest of the tied zero placeholder cells, never on a real score. Rounds 6-9 are NoTaskSet placeholders showing 0.

Penalty column observations: ZZIrvin 100, ZZNancarrow 200, ZZPotter 100 — per-pilot totals of four persisted Penalty=100 rows (pilots 42, 56 x2, 65); GS subtracts the total after summing the round cells (ZZNancarrow 3602 - 200 = 3402). Round cells themselves are pre-penalty NormalisedScore values.

Percent is display-only (100 x Score / winner Score) and deliberately not recorded; Score/Pcnt/Raw Score columns are not transcribed (Raw Score equals Score here — integral scores, GroupScoreDecimals=0).

Name-to-PilotNo mapping is doubly corroborated: transcript surnames match Pilots case-insensitively after trimming ('ZZPRATLEY, David' vs 'ZZPratley'), and the transcript Pilot column equals CompPilots.StartNo (UsePilotNumbering=true) — both mappings agree on all 10 pilots.

Independently validated 2026-08-26 against the documented ladder (arithmetic story THE LADDER): best-per-original-round normalised sum over rounds 1-9, one drop of the lowest cell with latest-equally-bad-first tie-break (Drop2@9 inactive — only 5 rounds with RawScore>0 exist), minus per-pilot penalty totals, re-round to 0 decimals, Score DESC / RawScore DESC — recomputed ranks agree with all 10 transcript ranks, all 10 Score values and pick the same dropped round (R9) for every pilot.
No ties: ranks display 1..10 without '=n'. Transcript header states '< Scores - Original >'.

GS 02 complete-result oracle (2026-10-01): Scope: 9 drawn rounds x 10 pilots (90 rows); R6-R9 are NoTaskSet placeholder zeros that sit in the rollup (the R9 zero is every pilot's transcript-evidenced drop) — included-in-standings R1-R9.
